payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics and comparisons for multilingual BERT (M-Bert) in various settings, indicating its effectiveness in multilingual tasks and zero-shot transfer capabilities.

claims.text: M-Bert performs consistently better than majority class baselines in cross-lingual and cross-target settings.
M-Bert shows some capability for zero-shot transfer to unseen languages and targets, although there is a performance gap that needs addressing.
M-Bert has established itself as state of the art for various multilingual tasks after being fine-tuned on specific tasks.
